ui:title: StackGuardian Runner Group - Azure
ui:description: Create a new StackGuardian Runner Group backed by Azure Blob Storage, with an Entra ID OIDC connector. Default tags are automatically applied: 'StackGuardian Private Runner', runner group name, and organization name.

api_key.ui:description: Your organization's API key (sgo_*/sgu_*) or a secret reference (${secret::SECRET_NAME})

org_name.ui:description: Your organization name. If not provided, will be extracted from environment.

azure_location.ui:description: The Azure region where the resource group and storage account will be deployed

create_azure_resource_group.ui:description: Create a new Azure Resource Group for the storage account. Disable to deploy into an existing resource group.

azure_resource_group_name.ui:description: Optional name override when creating the resource group; required when using an existing resource group.

create_blob_reader_role_assignment.ui:description: Grant the OIDC connector service principal 'Storage Blob Data Reader' on the storage account. Disable when the identity running Terraform lacks role-assignment write permission; you must then create the assignment out of band.

create_storage_backend.ui:description: Whether to create a new Azure Storage Account as the storage backend

account_tier.ui:description: Performance tier of the storage account

account_replication_type.ui:description: Replication strategy for the storage account

existing_azure_storage_account_name.ui:description: Name of an existing Azure Storage Account to use as storage backend

existing_azure_storage_account_access_ke.ui:description: Access key for the existing Azure Storage Account

global_prefix.ui:description: Prefix for the runner group and connector names. Leave empty to omit it.

runner_group_name.ui:description: Name half of the runner group; the full name is {prefix}-{name}. A short random string is generated when empty.

connector_name.ui:description: Name half of the connector. Defaults to the runner group's name.

max_runners.ui:description: Maximum number of runners allowed in the runner group
